$comment: Part I Section B — XML mapping for the contracting authority (buyer). Maps the instance-data fields to UBL cac:ContractingParty/cac:Party. The field set is the Schematron-mandated minimum (BR-REQ-20-02 name, BR-REQ-20-03 country, BR-REQ-20-04 identifier); address/contact/URIs are unconstrained and not modelled. The identifier scheme maps to @schemeID, whose value the CVA validates against EOIDType.gc (NOT @schemeAgencyID, which no rule constrains).

rules.$comment: BR-REQ-20-02 (fatal) — official name of the buyer.
BR-REQ-20-03 (fatal) — country of the buyer, as a bare Country code with the country codelist attributes.
BR-REQ-20-04 (warning) — party identifier value, with its scheme carried on @schemeID (EOIDType). Both roundtrip: the value as element text, the scheme as a data-sourced attribute.
